basic_info.description: Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a 1,460 sq ft top-floor light filled Edwardian flat in the heart of the sunny Mission District. This full-floor home blends classic San Francisco charm with modern comfort, featuring hardwood floors, coved ceilings, bay windows, and a mantled gas fireplace. With 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, the home is anchored by an updated kitchen with a large island that opens to the formal dining area, with elegant built-ins and box-beam ceilings. Off the kitchen, a light-filled laundry room leads directly to a private deck and a landscaped sunny shared back yard, perfect for morning coffee or evening meals. One-car straight in parking, incredible amount of  storage, and the ease of a self-managed low HOA make this home even more appealing. Step outside and the best of the city is at your doorstep. Rated a walker's, rider's, and biker's paradise, you're blocks from Valencia and Mission corridors, Dolores Park, and BART. Tech company shuttle buses stop right on this block, with UCSF, Kaiser, and Chase Center shuttles just a few blocks away. Quick freeway access makes commuting simple.
